notes:
Opportunity summary: KeenBridge is a product analytics SaaS that plans to add an AI-driven support assistant + contextual doc search. Currently on another LLM provider (OpenAI + custom proxy) for generation and embeddings. Evaluating Redwood Hosted as drop-in replacement for day-to-day, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and EU residency for enterprise customers.

Key points from calls: 
- 2024-11-03 demo: ran sample support flows, saw ~10-15% token cost delta vs current provider but latency improved on short chats. SE ran compat layer shim to map our existing API calls to Redwood endpoints.
- POC ask: host existing prompt-suite (~120 prompts) and evaluation harness; run A/B on 10k queries (mixed chat + rerank + embeds).
- Prompt parity: flagged 6 prompts with hallucination/regression vs baseline; need model fallback policy and prompt tweaks. "We need parity for outbound support responses or customers will notice differences" (CTO quote).
- Security: require SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS integration for customer keys. Legal asked for data residency guarantee for EU customers and retention controls.
- Billing: mid-market predictable commit desired (monthly reserved QPS), wants options for burst capacity. Pricing sensitivity: target ARR < $200k first year, ROI driven by reduced human TTR and ticket deflection.

Short-term actions: 
- SE (Marco) to run prompt parity eval and report diffs (due 2024-11-17).
- Schedule Dedicated POC (2-week) with reserved pool in us-east and eu-west to validate latency SLOs (AE to finalize).
- Legal to review contract template for EU residency clause — sent draft to counsel (Drive link).

Staging notes / shorthand: 
- POC metrics: latency p50 < 120ms for chat, p95 < 350ms for 1-2k qps burst, embedding throughput 60 qps baseline.
- Regressions tracked in eval sheet (see drive). Recommend canary + auto-fallback to smaller model family if regression rate > 3%.
- Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize for batch tuning and caching suggestions.
